in_marathi.name: Kamles
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamles हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kamala’ meaning ‘lotus’ and ‘Goddess Kamal’. Kamles is a name rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolizes beauty, grace, and divine protection.
